column1: # Nine Sols 1.3, Unity 2022.3.33f1 IL2CPP, SDK 18.3.2, NVN.
# The NPDM declares 8 MB of system resource. Unity uses virtual address memory and main sets a heap.
# Keep room for Unity's own regions in the iPhone layout (4.375 GB alias region). StandardAllocator reserves
# 3.14 GB (alias +0.06 .. +3.20) but maps well under 1 GB; Unity's own 16 MB chunks then ran out of address
# space past +4.38 GB (null allocation, sig 11 addr 0 at main+0x795b30, about 160 s in on the iPhone, and on the
# Mac with DM_ALIAS_SIZE=0x118000000). With the cap the same Mac run reached +3.76 GB and the iPhone +4.00 GB.
# Same shape and fix as Persona 5 Tactica (010087701B092000).
# The game calls nvnDeviceSetDepthMode with near = 0 in the heap check's boot.
